decisions.reason: The Aave provider and prize-pool yield behavior stated in the About copy are already fully represented by the candidate's message-156 INTRODUCE Event.
The only new commission detail at message 156, unlimited earnings with no expiration, is already represented by the same-message MODIFY; the other commission details remain unchanged.
The source leaves automatic delivery versus one-click claiming unresolved, and the candidate already records that same-message VALUE ambiguity; no definite MODIFY is entailed.
Message 156 explicitly revises the About Project Rebuild section, not the separately maintained FAQ content.
The About copy reiterates the existing Chainlink VRF, on-chain randomness, fairness, and ticket-weighted selection rules without changing them.
The About-page revision does not change which NFT state or entitlements transfer during a secondary sale.
The source reiterates that the mint number is the referral code and may be shared by number or link, which is already represented in current state.
The $15 mint price and existing commission and prize-pool allocation concepts are descriptive restatements and do not alter the current revenue-allocation state.
The source repeats the existing rule that a no-code mint awards the $5 commission to a random existing holder without changing its condition, amount, or selection method.
The stated five $10,000 prizes every 50,000 mint-and-secondary sales match the Big Block state already established before message 156.
The stated five $500 prizes every 500 mint-and-secondary sales match the Small Block state already established before message 156.
The About copy does not change metadata counter visibility, badge visibility, or the existing mint-number source of the referral-code attribute.
